encryption_details.algorithm: RC4 (standard 256-byte KSA and PRGA; no keystream drop)
encryption_details.key_storage: 16-byte plaintext static key in .rdata at RVA 0x4000 (VA 0x140004000); the 64-byte ciphertext is g_encrypted_payload in .data at RVA 0x3000 and is copied to the stack before in-place decryption

decoded_strings.note: The RC4-protected object is a 64-byte executable payload, not a textual string. No encrypted textual strings were identified; ntdll.dll and the Nt* export names are stored in plaintext.

anti_analysis: Checks the first four bytes of the ntdll NtAllocateVirtualMemory export for the canonical x64 syscall-stub prologue 4C 8B D1 B8, providing user-mode hook/stub-tampering detection
Extracts syscall service numbers from ntdll export stubs and falls back to scanning the first 32 bytes for a B8 imm32 pattern when the canonical prologue is absent
Resolves ntdll exports dynamically with GetModuleHandleA/GetProcAddress rather than importing the Nt* routines directly

injection_details.method: In-process shellcode execution using VirtualAlloc + memcpy + CreateThread; no remote-process injection is implemented
injection_details.target_discovery: No external target discovery. GetCurrentProcess is called, but its pseudo-handle is not used for allocation or writing.
injection_details.payload_write: A 64-byte encrypted blob is copied from .data to a stack buffer, RC4-decrypted in place, then copied with memcpy into VirtualAlloc(NULL, 0x40, MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE) memory.
injection_details.execution: CreateThread starts directly at the allocated buffer; the sample waits up to 5000 ms and closes the thread handle.
injection_details.unused_injection_indicators: Strings for NtOpenProcess and NtQueueApcThread are resolved for syscall-number inspection only; neither remote process opening nor APC injection is performed. The invoke_syscall function is an inert stub returning STATUS_UNSUCCESSFUL and no direct syscall instruction is used.
